title: Bio-Mechanical Greenhouse Pavilion Designer
description: The user designs a futuristic bio-mechanical greenhouse pavilion where rotating gear mechanisms control the opening and closing of dome panels, revealing avocado trees growing inside. Users must configure gear speed, panel count, dome radius, lighting warmth, tree placement, and growth scale to achieve an optimal greenhouse environment score displayed on a HUD.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Bio-Mechanical Greenhouse Pavilion Designer. Load both 'shared_assets/gears.glb' and 'shared_assets/Avocado.glb' using GLTFLoader.

Scene setup: Place a circular platform (radius 8) as the pavilion base on a ground plane with subtle grid texture. Position the camera at (0, 12, 20) looking at origin. Use OrbitControls for navigation. Add ambient light (intensity 0.4), a warm directional light simulating sun, and a point light inside the dome.

Architecture: Arrange 6 gear models evenly around the platform edge at radius 9, scaled to 3x. These gears visually drive the dome mechanism. Above them, create 6 translucent dome panel segments (CylinderGeometry arcs or custom shapes) forming a retractable dome. Place 5 Avocado models inside the dome area in a cross pattern, scaled 15x to represent bio-architectural growing pods.

Interactions (7 steps with validation): 1) A slider 'Gear Speed' (0.1-3.0, default 1.0) controls gear rotation speed (all gears animate spinning). 2) A slider 'Panel Count' (3-8, integer) regenerates dome panels dynamically. 3) A slider 'Dome Radius' (5-12, default 8) resizes the dome and repositions gears. 4) A 'Dome Open' slider (0-100%) interpolates panels upward to reveal interior. 5) A dropdown to select avocado arrangement pattern: 'cross', 'circle', 'random' — repositions avocado models accordingly. 6) A slider 'Growth Scale' (5-25) uniformly scales all avocado models. 7) A color picker 'Sun Warmth' adjusts the directional light color from cool white to warm amber.

Display a HUD panel showing a computed 'Greenhouse Score' (0-100) based on: dome openness (higher is better), gear speed (moderate is best), growth scale (larger is better), and sun warmth (warmer scores higher). Validate all slider inputs are within range. Use dat.gui or custom HTML overlay for controls. Animate gears continuously. Add subtle fog for atmosphere.
